line.name: E.P. Carrillo Interlude Maduro
line.background_text: Interlude debuted at the 2016 IPCPR trade show as part of E.P. Carrillo's 'Dimension Series,' created to fill a portfolio gap for short, thinner, quick smokes. The Maduro blend pairs a sweet, dark Mexican San Andres wrapper with an Ecuadorian binder and Nicaraguan long-filler, handmade at Tabacalera La Alianza. NOTE: Maduro and Natural are two SEPARATE BLENDS sharing only the line name and vitola sizes, not simple wrapper variants of one recipe.

vitolas.summary_review: Dry and earthy with a dense, chalky/nutty character; rated in the mid-80s by reviewers.
Marketed as 'the shortest cigar I've ever made'; medium-strength with the Maduro's San Andres wrapper character.
